relations: The hand grips the fold where two strands of magnetic spheres meet, holding the loop open on the white surface.
The linked metallic balls form a flexible chain whose shape depends on the hand's grip at the junction.
If the hand releases the fold, the magnetic strands may slide apart or collapse toward each other.
The chain's continuity persists as long as magnetic attraction links each sphere to its neighbors.
